mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 60 trading days signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 60 days, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% within a 5-day window, it indicates imminent labor market deterioration that triggers equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% within 5 days, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) over 60 days indicates demand destruction amid price pressures, which consistently produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles where the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for 5 consecutive days, higher discount rates suppress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 5 days, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over 60 trading days signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases over 60 days, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500.0 thousand units within a 5-day window, it signals weakening residential demand that precedes equity market declines, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST < 1500.0 within 5 days, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over 60 days indicates supply chain disruptions combined with labor market weakness, consistently producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain recovery phases where industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.0 for 5 consecutive days, improved manufacturing output boosts corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0 for 5 days, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
